Anant Singh Bail Cancelled : bihar ki rajniti se is vakt ki bari khabar hai. mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ko suprim kort se bara jhatka laga hai. unki jamanat radd kar di gaee hai aur unhen 1 disanbar tak sarendar karne ka aadesh diya gaya hai. suprim kort ke is phaisle ke bad anant sinh ki mushkilen barh gaee hain. ab saval hai ki kya 'chhote sarkar' ko ek bar phir jel jana hoga? dekhie is pure mamle ki vistrit riporta.
